## What this letter says
This letter is from one doctor to another doctor. It is about Mr. Sample Patient. He wants sperm harvesting (taking sperm). The letter asks for the plan, so the procedure can be arranged.

Here is what the letter says:
- He had a vasectomy 10 years ago.
- He had a failed vasectomy reversal almost 2 years ago. It was at the University of Michigan.
- He has had no sperm in his semen (azoospermic) since that operation.
- The operation note suggests some sperm and sperm head may have been present on the right side. This is possible, not certain.
- Several attempts at ovulation induction for his wife did not work. This was apparently due to an anatomic abnormality.
- He is interested in sperm harvesting and cryopreservation before his wife's next ovulation induction.
- He asked for cryopreservation when he left the office. A later phone call suggested something different. He may want a fresh specimen harvest instead.
- He does not want to do the harvesting at all unless his wife's ovulation is confirmed. This comes from the phone call.

## What you need to do
1. The letter does not ask you to do anything.
2. The writing doctor asks the other doctor to reply with the plan. The doctor will do this, not you.

## Dates and medicines
- No medicines are listed in the letter.
- No dates are given. The visit date and the harvest date were left blank. The harvest date may change if a fresh specimen is needed.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What does azoospermic mean for me?
- What are cryopreservation and a fresh specimen harvest?
- When will the plan be sent to the hospital?
- When will the date for the procedure be set?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
